name: Brewer's Trade
summary: A trade has been worked out with the Dun Garok brew-kin, who miss the Fallrook family's vineyards as much as anyone. A case of Fallrook Varietal travels to their fort in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills, and a sack of their Homebrew Hops comes back.

sections.title: A Taste of the Past
sections.body: Most of the best bottled years of Fallrook wine are long since drunk, but cases of the Fallrook Varietal still sit in the cellars. The Dun Garok brew-kin miss the vineyards of the Fallrook family too, and a trade has been worked out with them.

sections.title: The Exchange at Dun Garok
sections.body: The case goes southeast to Dun Garok, to be left with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, down at the base of their fort. In return, you carry a sack of their Homebrew Hops back.

faq.q: What is being traded in this exchange?
faq.answer: A case of Fallrook Varietal wine, from the cellars, goes to the Dun Garok brew-kin in return for a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

faq.q: Where in Dun Garok does the wine need to go?
faq.answer: You leave it with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, down at the base of their fort.
Dun Garok lies in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Fallrooks were a family whose vineyards are missed. Most of their best bottled years have long since been drunk, though cases of the wine remain in the cellars.
